text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер and I have come to the
track to
watch some races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There she goes! Laser focused! Blazing
ahead and
across the finish liiine!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
I know we planned to watch races
today... But do
you mind if we do
something different?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Listening to all those cheers. I can't just
stand
around twiddling my thumbs.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Let's head back and do some laps.
Observation is a part of your training.

text_block_list.text:
Listening to all those cheers. I can't just
stand
around twiddling my thumbs.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Let's head back and do some laps.
Observation is a part of your training.

text_block_list.text:
Let's hurry, then. We must begin before
this fire
within me dims.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: We'll do extra training tomorrow, okay?

text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Fair enough. I look forward to
what you
plan on adding.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Right now... I'll pay full attention to
these races
and preserve this urge to
fuel me for tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We head back to the academy together,
and
Grass Wonder runs late into the
night.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
For the rest of our time at the venue,
Grass
Wonder observes every race with
hawk-like
attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
